name: Gästehaus Gapp
beschreibung:
Idyllically situated on the sunny plateau in Wildermieming, Gaestehaus Gapp provides a serene escape framed by open meadows and mountain backdrops. Cosy rooms ensure relaxation.

Scenic hiking paths, cycling trails, cross-country tracks, and the Mieming Plateau golf course are easily reachable.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Gapp in Wildermieming offers peaceful holidays on the sunny Mieming Plateau.
